forum.title: ITTIA DB Support on the STM32C5 Series
forum.best_answer_content:
On our [website for partner solutions](https://www.st.com/content/st_com/en/partner/partner-program.html), you will find initial information about [ITTIA](https://www.st.com/content/st_com/en/partner/partner-program/partnerpage/ITTIA.html) and [ITTIA DB](https://www.st.com/en/partner-products-and-services/ittia-db.html#product-details).

ITTIA provides its commercial application as a binary for various STM32 based on Cortex-M4, Cortex-M7, Cortex-M33 and Cortex-A7. ITTIA can certainly inform you when the STM32C5, which is also based on Cortex-M33, will be supported.

ITTIA\_DB is already offered by CubeMX as an Embedded Package. However, since the current version 8.9.0 is somewhat outdated, you should also ask ITTIA if they can provide information on integrating it into your own project.

Hope that helps?

Regards

/Peter
forum.content_text:
Hi,

I would like to inquire whether the STM32C5 series supports ITTIA DB. Additionally, is it possible to use this library directly within CubeMX for development?
